During the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy<ref name="TEA" /> between [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Species/Legends|species]] '''attacked''' the [[Vandyne system/Legends|Vandyne system]]. Taking place at a point between 25 ABY and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the assault was preceded by an [[Attack on the Vinsoth system|attack]] on the [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth system]], where the Yuuzhan Vong split their forces to strike several target [[Star system/Legends|systems]] including one group that traveled to the [[Axxila system/Legends|Axxila system]] and then used a [[Axxila–Tangrene hyperlane/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected Axxila to the [[Tangrene system/Legends|Tangrene system]] via several other systems, to reach the Vandyne system. After the attack on the Vandyne system, the Yuuzhan Vong advanced further along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to [[Attack on the Edusa system|attack]] the [[Edusa system/Legends|Edusa system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Vandyne system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2009]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The Atlas included the attack in a map titled "Vector Prime and the Yuuzhan Vong advance" which showed the movements and conflicts of the various factions involved in the Yuuzhan Vong War, between 25 ABY and 26 ABY. The book gives no information on the outcome of the attack, but a separate map shows the Vandyne system was under Yuuzhan Vong control by 26 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />
